## Summary:

Significant interplanetary shock detected by DSCOVR at L1 at 2024-05-16T04:35Z. 

The cause for this shock is still under analysis. Strong magnetospheric compression possible and geomagnetic storm observed with Kp=6.00 observed during synoptic period 2024-05-16T06:00Z - 2024-05-16T09:00Z. 

Activity ID: 2024-05-16T04:35:00-IPS-001.
